authorized_changes_only: Canonicalize every host-side bind source path with pathlib.Path(...).resolve() before docker invocation.
Require every host bind source path to be absolute before candidate execution.
Introduce an orthogonal source-independent bind-transport preflight before consuming the frozen candidate lattice.
Classify docker daemon/CLI failure before container start, including exit 125 caused by invalid bind syntax, as DISCOVERY_INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE rather than SOURCE_RUNTIME_INCOMPATIBLE.
Abort the v2 authority immediately on discovery infrastructure failure; do not consume later candidates.
Record container_started/probe_result_present evidence so candidate incompatibility is only assigned after the inside probe actually starts and emits a readable result.
forbidden_changes: reorder, remove, add, or skip candidate tags
change any Better Thermostat source commit or blueprint identity
change inside component import obligations in response to a candidate result
execute or expose VE2 transition fixtures, expected frontiers, or historical actions
reinterpret an actual inside-probe incompatibility as infrastructure failure

v2_failure_taxonomy.IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE: candidate-specific only when docker pull fails with a registry/image availability error
v2_failure_taxonomy.DISCOVERY_INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE: host/docker transport failure before a candidate inside probe begins or before a readable probe result is emitted
v2_failure_taxonomy.SOURCE_RUNTIME_INCOMPATIBLE: candidate-specific only when container start succeeded and the inside probe emitted a readable FAIL result or exited nonzero after probe start
v2_failure_taxonomy.PASS: inside probe emitted PASS, docker exit is zero, and image/source identities satisfy all frozen obligations

next_gate: Build a minimal v2 public remediation source from the failed v1 source, independently verify only the authorized transport/taxonomy delta, then open one fresh v2 authority.
